name: colony stimulating factor 1 receptor
pathways: positive regulation of protein tyrosine kinase activity

function.text: CSF1R encodes macrophage colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor. Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine kinase activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein tyrosine kinase activity and signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to brain abnormalities, neurodegeneration, and dysosteosclerosis (autosomal recessive); leukoencephalopathy, diffuse hereditary, with spheroids 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Invasive Breast Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
